annotations.title: Change a tool's words or store listings

description: The tool's name, its line, its description, its Chrome Web Store listing (storeUrl) or its Microsoft Edge Add-ons listing (edgeUrl), each the store link or the 32-letter id, on Test. Only what is sent changes. A store listing makes that store's copy one the tool key opens for: set it once the item exists. Edge gives the extension an id of its own, so a tool on both stores names both.

tool.description: The tool id, as toolaby_list_tools gives it (like "acme--word-counter"); the short one ("word-counter") works when it names one tool.

name: toolaby_update_tool
